{{Quote|Hmm... these maps show outside incursions into Hutt Space from some unknown force. Fifteen in all... they lost a lot of ground.|Captain [[Hardin (captain)|Hardin]]|<ref name="Karagga" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Dread Host]]&mdash;Imperial forces under the control of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]]&mdash;launched a series of '''attacks''' on [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Dread Masters caused events such as a panicked mass exodus from [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] and the destruction of entire fleets over [[Cyborrea/Legends|Cyborrea]] with a [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|Force illusion]]. Additionally, their warships captured or destroyed a total of fifteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]]&mdash;including the world that housed the favorite holiday estate of [[Karagga]] the Unyielding, the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] Supreme Mogul. As a result, the Cartel launched their own attacks on Republic and Imperial space to regain their lost territory.<ref name="Karagga" />
